immutable_architecture.literal_reuse: atom8; causal binary-counter lifting hierarchy; G4 grouped variance; K4/group16 routing; existing reserves and lambdas; authoritative FP16-K rerank; FP16-V output; traffic accounting; physical-query geometry; metrics

selection_policy: Deterministic dataset index order. Eligible rows inspect only identity/index, required text-field existence, string type, character count, and frozen Qwen3-1.7B tokenizer bounded length >=4096. First eligible unused is calibration and second is validation. No semantics, topic, difficulty, Q/K/V, attention, routing, CascadeKV result, perplexity, or model quality was inspected. Existing-manifest preflight only loads/verifies; it never reselects.
original_v3_mechanics: Independently evaluate A0-A4 at every physical query. Aggregate calibration action rows by layer×KV-head. Solve exact multiple-choice static DP using integer microbytes under a mean total K+V cap: objective lexicographically minimizes summed relative-L2, then maximizes summed cosine, then minimizes traffic, then lexical A0..A4 table code. Retain one lexicographic winner per exact traffic and prune traffic states dominated in (relative-L2,-cosine). Apply each calibration-frozen table to validation only; traffic is total quantized-K bytes plus selected FP16-V bytes.

traffic_targets.T0: mean calibration total K+V of frozen_cascadekv_v2
traffic_targets.T1: T0 + 0.5 * (mean calibration total K+V of uniform_v1_10 - T0)
traffic_targets.T2: mean calibration total K+V of uniform_v1_10

calibration_validation_separation: Only the three calibration sources may enter action aggregation, DP state, candidate construction, or static-table optimization. Freeze T0/T1/T2 tables before scoring the three distinct validation sources. No per-source or per-query schedule.
development_success_rule: 1P7B-V-AWARE-STATIC-PROMISING iff at least one calibration-derived candidate has pooled validation cosine >= 0.985, pooled validation relative-L2 <= 0.120, mean total K+V <= uniform_v1_10, and strictly improves validation relative-L2 over both frozen_cascadekv_v2 and original_frozen_cascadekv_v3_zero_shot on the same fresh validation queries; otherwise 1P7B-V-AWARE-STATIC-NOT-PROMISING.
winner_rule: T0/T1/T2 are predeclared calibration traffic targets inherited from the original methodology, and their order T0, T1, T2 is fixed before validation. Evaluate the already-predeclared validation gates for each candidate: cosine >= 0.985; relative-L2 <= 0.120; mean total K+V <= uniform_v1_10 on the same validation queries; and relative-L2 strictly lower than both frozen_cascadekv_v2 and original_frozen_cascadekv_v3_zero_shot validation relative-L2. Select the first passing predeclared target in fixed order T0, then T1, then T2; if none pass, there is no winner. Validation is used only to determine each frozen candidate's pass/fail and cannot reorder candidates by realized K+V, relative-L2, or cosine. Exactly one candidate named target_vaware_T0, target_vaware_T1, and target_vaware_T2 is required before selection; missing, duplicate, unknown, or malformed candidate sets fail closed with no winner. This prospective clarification minimizes validation-driven model selection for the fresh 1.7B development experiment; it makes no claim about the historical 0.6B winner rule.
diagnostics: Posthoc static layer×KV-head and per-query oracles, if later reproduced, are POSTHOC DIAGNOSTIC — NOT A CANDIDATE and cannot affect selection.
leakage_statement: Archived 1.7B test pooled, partition, query, layer, head, action, and traffic metrics are not algorithm inputs. No consumed identity may be reused. No threshold, action definition, router representation, reserve, lambda, quantization, or context-length parameter changed. No 8K and no untouched confirmatory test selection are authorized.
